policy.authorization_rule: The complete macro body, claim ID, and manuscript section must exactly match authorized_tex and allowed_locations.
policy.artifact_rule: Quantitative table or figure claims require an authorized artifact ID, generated output, provenance sidecar, and manuscript binding.
policy.prose_rule: Claim-bearing quantitative, accuracy, validation, parity, and performance prose outside a registered macro or artifact is prohibited.
policy.working_tree_rule: Uncommitted scientific inputs are never evidence; paper-owned generated sources are hash-bound pending integration.
policy.campaign_macro_rule: A section admitted by a numerical-campaign gate may render numbers only through evidence macros whose value, artifact path, JSON pointer and SHA-256 are recorded in the campaign's evidence file and regenerated from the sealed bundle by the checker; the section may type no literal digit, and its claim-bearing sentences remain exact EvidenceClaim bodies bound to the campaign manifest.
policy.section_input_rule: Files bound through \input{sections/...} are flattened into the manuscript before every claim, citation and prose check; a section is not a way around the matrix.

claims.authorized_tex: A preregistered one-shot collisionless test-particle campaign of \WlfPooledTrials{} electron orbits in a qualified finite-element magnetostatic field is admitted as numerical evidence: it recorded \WlfPooledReflected{} reflections and a per-cell bimodal wall-hit pattern, and it is neither a self-consistent plasma calculation nor a thruster-performance result.
permitted_scope: existence and preregistered one-shot status of the admitted campaign
macro-bound orbit count and reflection count
qualitative per-cell bimodality as detailed by CLM-013
the not-self-consistent and not-performance boundary

claims.authorized_tex: The run terminated in state \texttt{\WlfTerminalState} with \WlfGatesTrue{} of \WlfGateCount{} binding gates true and \WlfValidatorsPassed{} validator calls with \WlfValidatorsFailed{} failures; every case was re-integrated by the exact authority replay (\WlfReplayCount{} replays). Within the collisionless prescribed-field test-particle model classified as \texttt{\WlfClassification}, the wall-hit probability lies between \WlfWallPMin{} and \WlfWallPMax{} across the \WlfCaseCount{} preregistered cases with \texttt{\WlfIntervalMethod} intervals; pooled with equal weights over all \WlfPooledTrials{} orbits it is \WlfPooledWallP{} (interval [\WlfPooledWallLo, \WlfPooledWallHi]), with \WlfPooledEscape{} domain escapes (\WlfPooledEscapeP), exactly \WlfPooledReflected{} reflections and \WlfPooledIncomplete{} timeouts or numerical failures. The pooled value averages a bimodal per-cell result: the two interior cells lose every launch to the wall (\WlfCellTwoThreeWall{} of \WlfCellTwoThreeTrials), the exit cell beyond the dielectric end escapes entirely (\WlfCellFourEscape{} of \WlfCellFourTrials), and the injector-side cell depends on the launch direction (\WlfCellOneMinusWallP{} wall loss for launches toward the injector plane against \WlfCellOnePlusWallP, that is \WlfCellOnePlusWall{} of \WlfCellOnePlusTrials, toward the exit).
allowed_locations: Collisionless full-orbit electron wall loss in the divergent-exit field
claims.evidence_level_justification: The campaign is numerical evidence about a collisionless, prescribed-field, test-particle model of electron orbits in one qualified P2 magnetostatic field, verified at the code level (manufactured helix orders, CPU/CUDA parity, exact authority replay) and at the solution level (timestep refinement, field-map refinement and enlargement, exact energy gate, Wilson intervals). The framework's only mechanism for accepted numerical evidence is the one used for L0: a typed committed manifest, artifacts bound by Git blob and SHA-256 at a resolvable revision, exact registered claim text, and generated artifacts with provenance sidecars. That mechanism is applied here through the numerical-campaign gate GATE-WALL-LOSS-V4. The campaign is not a field-resolved reduced performance model (no L0 mapping; the coupling export is export-only), not a coupled hybrid plasma model, and neither particle-in-cell nor experimental, so it is recorded outside the L1--L3 ladder and opens none of those gates; its tier in the V&V protocol is verification, never validation.

The maximum relative kinetic-energy drift over all orbits is \WlfEnergyErrorMax{} against a gate of \WlfEnergyGate{} (\WlfEnergyExceed{} orbits above the gate, \WlfVelocityMismatch{} final-velocity/event-velocity mismatches); the maximum wall-endpoint error is \WlfWallEndpointErr{} m against \WlfWallEndpointGate{} m; the manufactured helix orders are \WlfHelixOrders{} and the CPU/CUDA relative velocity difference is \WlfCudaParity.

claims.authorized_tex: Within a collisionless, prescribed-field, test-particle model (\texttt{\WlfClassification}), electrons launched in the two interior cells of the straight channel reach the dielectric on their first pass regardless of energy, pitch or direction, electrons launched beyond the dielectric end leave the domain, and only launches nearest the injector plane show any direction dependence. No orbit reflected (\WlfPooledReflected{} of \WlfPooledTrials), so a mirror or loss-cone description does not apply to this field and design (mirror-formula publication forbidden: \WlfForbidMirror). The pooled fraction \WlfPooledWallP{} is an equal-weight design average of a bimodal per-cell result and is not a physical loss rate. The result is not a particle-in-cell or self-consistent plasma calculation (forbidden: \WlfForbidPic), not thruster performance (forbidden: \WlfForbidPerformance), and carries no hardware or experimental validation (claimed: \WlfHardwareValidation). The coupling export (\texttt{\WlfCouplingQuantity} $= \WlfCouplingP \pm \WlfCouplingU$) has status \texttt{\WlfCouplingStatus}; no consumer model has ingested it.
allowed_locations: Collisionless full-orbit electron wall loss in the divergent-exit field
permitted_scope: model-bounded restatement of the per-cell outcome
absence of reflections and the sealed publication boundary flags
design-average status of the pooled fraction
unconsumed coupling export
prohibited_inferences: mirror or loss-cone formulas for this field

claims.authorized_tex: Because \WlfPooledReflected{} of the \WlfPooledTrials{} integrated electrons reflected before reaching a boundary, the magnetic-mirror picture of wall loss used by the original design study is not supported for this field and design within the collisionless prescribed-field test-particle model: the outcome is a split between wall capture and axial escape that is decided almost entirely by the launch cell.
permitted_scope: model-bounded inference from the exact zero reflection count
identification of the legacy mirror-ratio acceptance-angle closure documented by the audit and provenance records
prohibited_inferences: loss rates of a real electron population
mirror behaviour in other fields, designs or collisional regimes
existence or stability of a multi-cell wall-cusp topology
numerical impact on the legacy publication run
